name: What is the typical cost range for a guest bathroom remodel in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a guest bathroom remodel in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a guest bathroom remodel in Las Vegas can vary significantly based on material choices, fixtures, and the extent of structural changes. Minor refreshes involving paint, new hardware, and a vanity might start around $5,000 to $10,000. More extensive renovations, including replacing showers, flooring, and reconfiguring layouts, can range from $15,000 to $30,000 or more. High-end finishes and custom features will naturally increase the total investment. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Guest bathroom remodels in Las Vegas typically range from $5,000 for minor updates to $30,000+ for extensive renovations, depending on materials and scope.
